Kirk Cousins was born in Barrington, IL. How tall is Kirk Cousins? Kirk Cousins is 6-3 (190 cm) tall. How much does Kirk Cousins weigh? Kirk Cousins weighs 205 lbs (92 kg). How many games does Kirk Cousins play? Kirk Cousins played 10 games last season and 174 games over his career. How many passing yards does Kirk Cousins have? Kirk Cousins had 1,721 passing yards last season and 44,700 passing yards over his career. How many touchdowns does Kirk Cousins have? Kirk Cousins had 10 touchdowns last season and 298 touchdowns over his career. How many Super Bowls has Kirk Cousins won? Kirk Cousins has never won a Super Bowl.
